data.content_ref: inline:The relation is mislabeled and internally inconsistent. It claims 0d16ae40c2a5 'abstracts' SRC_002's Map vs Terrain analogy, but the 'refuted if' clause asserts that strict adherence to the 'map' (checklist) produces higher outcome probability than terrain-verification — which is precisely the pro-checklist position SRC_002 argues for. An abstraction that is refuted by a re-instantiation of the very thing it abstracts from is incoherent: the endpoints are in a contradiction/reduction relation, not an abstraction. Naming it 'abstraction' while the refutation condition presupposes the abstraction's source is the stronger claim violates the requirement to name the kind correctly.
